given: an inactive vehicle with a valid template and schedule slot, and no binding
a Supervisor, an Administrator, a Crew member, and a Supply Officer
an item obligation created by a binding effective while the vehicle is active, with its due instant at or after a proposed unbind instant
when: the Supervisor records a binding while the vehicle is inactive, then the vehicle is activated
the Administrator records a future binding and time advances from before its effective instant to that instant
Crew and Supply Officer attempt the same binding through direct requests
a user requests an unbind preview, then relevant configuration changes before confirmation
the user refreshes the preview and confirms unbinding, then replays the same operation id
then: the Supervisor and Administrator are allowed to bind and unbind; Crew and Supply Officer are denied server-side
no obligations are generated while the vehicle is inactive; an in-force binding begins obligations at activation
the future binding creates no obligations before its effective instant and begins at that instant if the vehicle is active
the unbind preview identifies unsatisfied obligations due at or after unbinding that will retire, and states they are not satisfied
confirmation of a stale preview is refused and a refreshed preview is required
obligations due before unbinding retain their state; checks, deficiencies and audit history remain
replaying the confirmed operation id does not apply unbinding a second time
notes: Language-neutral contract for owner-approved SPEC amendment 4.1.0 (issue #177). The scenario is not yet bound to application commands.
